metricDefinitions.brierScore: mean per-match sum of three squared errors; lower is better
metricDefinitions.logLoss: mean negative log probability assigned to actual outcome; lower is better

marketBlendV2Revision.note: Append-only revision; the prior 13 V2 rows remain verbatim. The scoring script selects the latest appended row per match.

goalExpectancyRevision.method: Blend expected-goal difference rather than 1X2 probabilities: marketDiff=(homeVoteShare-awayVoteShare)*1.6; blendedDiff=0.3*(modelHomeXG-modelAwayXG)+0.7*marketDiff; preserve model total expected goals and recover home/away XG from total and blended difference.
goalExpectancyRevision.probabilityConversion: GPT independent Poisson score distribution (0..10 goals, normalized).
goalExpectancyRevision.caveat: Claude's Dixon-Coles correction and V2 draw-boost implementation details were not available, so only the expected-goal blending stage is aligned. Final probabilities are not asserted to be numerically identical to Claude V2.

claudeV2AlignedRevision.method: Same Claude V2 expected-goal blend formula: market edge=(home vote share-away vote share)*1.6; 30% model edge and 70% market edge; preserve total expected goals; minimum 0.15 goals per side.
claudeV2AlignedRevision.probabilityConversion: 0..8 independent Poisson score matrix, Dixon-Coles rho=-0.10 on 0-0/0-1/1-0/1-1, normalize once, then V2 draw boost for |home-away|<0.30 with amount 0.20.
claudeV2AlignedRevision.marketSnapshotSource: Claude-provided official vote-share snapshot displayed at 2026-10-24 00:59 JST; not independently verified.
claudeV2AlignedRevision.caveat: Final probabilities differ if GPT expected-goal inputs differ from Claude's raw expected-goal inputs.
